evidence: Nestled within the vibrant heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, Hang Thiec Street, also known as Phố Hàng Thiếc, stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of traditional craftsmanship. Emerging from the bustling tapestry of the thirty-six streets, this narrow thoroughfare has been a hub of metalworking since the fifteenth century.
